full_judgment: 144. On perusal of the evidences of records I find that PW 1, 2, 3 and PW 10 are the eye witnesses of the occurrences amongst them. PW 1, 2 and 3 are the members of the joint force who are eye witnesses of the occurrence of higgling by the convicts due to which 3(three) members of the joint force namely PC Kanchan, MH Kabir and MA Islam were compelled to fell down into the river and consequently they died drowning due to asphyxia resulting from and found injuries. As per opinion of the PW 4 Dr Abdus Salam who held the post mortem. PW 10 Nirapada Sarker is an independent local witness, who said that the persons who got up in his trawler from Birat Boraj Bunia, those persons were taken out from his trawler by the members of the joint force. Also he has stated that he was detained by the joint force on that day when those persons were taken from his trawler and he has set at free in the following day in the evening.
